from test2026.cuda.qwen38_5090.b4_resident_serial_graph_gate import admit as admit_graphs
        control_ids={r['id'] for g in report['boundary_controls'] for r in g['results']}|{r['id'] for r in report['stream_controls']}
        assert len(control_ids)==31
        # Completion precedes its optional diagnostic line. Wait only for the
        # logger to receive that line, then evaluate counters once, before805.
        snapshot_deadline=time.monotonic()+10
        while True:
            graph_raw=(out/'worker/worker-stdout.jsonl').read_bytes();snapshot_ids=set()
            for line in graph_raw.splitlines():
                try:event=json.loads(json.loads(line)['line'])
                except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError):continue
                if isinstance(event,dict) and event.get('event')=='study_graph_snapshot':snapshot_ids.update(event['request_ids'])
            if snapshot_ids==control_ids:break
            assert time.monotonic()<snapshot_deadline,'Missing actual graph snapshots'
            time.sleep(.01)
        report['graph_usage']=admit_graphs(graph_raw,control_ids)
        report['status']='collecting805';save()
